title: Graffiti Restoration
description: A woman in an orange jumpsuit stands on debris-covered floor, spray-painting a large ornate wall mural featuring swirling smoke, gears, and a reaching hand. In the background, a man in dark tactical gear and hat stands under dramatic theatrical spotlights in a dilapidated art gallery.
prompt: A woman in an orange jumpsuit with a spray can is carefully painting an intricate classical mural on a decaying gallery wall, the mural shows swirling smoke, mechanical gears and a reaching hand. A man in dark tactical gear and wide-brimmed hat stands watch in the background. Broken frames and glass litter the floor, dramatic theatrical spotlights cut through the dusty air, cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere.
